messages:
Sam (Events): Quick sync: all-hands starts in 12. Small run-of-show change 010s12D -> moving roadmap to after Q&A so we can handle extra questions. Can AV confirm recorder + captions are green?
Kai (Eng): On the encoder test now. OBS threw a dropped-frames warning at 4k, switching to 720p/30 as a fallback. Will report stability in 30s.
Maya (Audio): Hearing a buzz on stage mic 1 when phantom power on. Swapping to handheld now, will test levels.
Sam (Events): If swap takes >1 minute we'll call a 2-minute warm buffer before the start. Need someone to update the attendee chat with caption lag note.
Tess (Comms): I'll post a pinned message in #all-hands: "Live captions may be delayed ~20s; recording will be available after the event." Sending now.
deploy-bot: Scheduled stream job check: ingest endpoint ok, token expiry in 22m. https://internal.rec/checks/198999
Kai (Eng): Encoder stable at 720p/30, CPU usage down to 48%. No frame drops in 60s.
Nina (Ops): Confirmed: adjusted ACLs to allow encoder host outbound RTMP. Increased network priority for 10.0.3.45.
Maya (Audio): Handheld levels good, no buzz. :thumbsup:
Liam (Product): Leadership prefer condensed roadmap (8m) + Q&A first? Jules?
Jules (CEO): Let's lead with Q&A, then condensed roadmap and demos. If we run out of time, team will post demo recordings and notes.
Sam (Events): Recording backup plan: Tess is capturing locally, Kai running cloud ingest. Who will upload raw after?
Tess (Comms): I'll upload local capture to the shared drive within 45 minutes post-event.
Kai (Eng): Also enabled reconnect retries on the encoder to handle transient network hitches.
Sam (Events): Final checklist: captions link in chat (done), backup recorder armed (Tess), mic swapped (Maya), encoder fallback (Kai). Warm count T-3.
Liam (Product): For follow-ups: 1) collect unanswered Qs and tag owners 2) record requests for extended demos 3) ensure transcript posted with timestamps.
Jules (CEO): Thanks team. If anything unexpected pops up, Sam call the show and we pause.
Sam (Events): Thanks all 12: starting warm count T-2.
